home.title: Radio Atlantida
home.intro: This is the station management panel. Pages for the library, playlists, play rules, and settings will appear in the navigation as they are added.

alerts.panelError: The panel had an unexpected error.

settings.reconnectNotice: Saved. The new value takes effect when the connection is opened again. Changing the stream server briefly interrupts the stream.

problems.bad_request: The request could not be read.
problems.validation_failed: Some fields are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
problems.not_found: The requested item was not found.
problems.method_not_allowed: This action is not supported here.
problems.body_too_large: The data sent is too large.
problems.unsupported_media_type: The data was sent in a format the server does not accept.
problems.not_acceptable: The server cannot answer in the requested format.
problems.internal_error: The server had an internal error. The error is in the logs.
problems.log_file_not_found: The log file was not found.
problems.setting_not_editable: This setting cannot be changed in the panel.
problems.playlist_type_not_found: The playlist type was not found.
problems.system_type_not_deletable: A system playlist type cannot be deleted.
problems.playlist_type_in_use: The playlist type is in use and cannot be deleted.
problems.playlist_in_use: The playlist is used by clocks and cannot be deleted.
problems.artist_in_use: The artist is in use and cannot be deleted.
problems.artist_has_history: The artist has play history and cannot be deleted.
problems.track_in_use: The track is in use and cannot be deleted.
problems.track_has_history: The track has play history and cannot be deleted.
problems.track_file_not_found: The audio file of the track was not found.
problems.play_rule_not_found: The play rule was not found.
problems.play_rule_in_use: The play rule is in use and cannot be deleted.
problems.separation_rule_not_found: The separation rule was not found.
problems.clock_in_use: The clock is used in the grid and cannot be deleted.
problems.clock_has_history: The clock has play history and cannot be deleted.
problems.grid_slot_not_found: The grid slot was not found.
problems.grid_conflict: Another change to the same grid hours was saved at the same time. Reload the grid and try again.
problems.filler_request_not_found: The filler reminder was not found.
problems.filler_request_closed: The filler reminder is already closed.
problems.filler_request_not_answerable: This reminder is closed by refilling the clock's filler pool, not by choosing a track.
problems.hour_started: This hour is on air, over, or about to start, so its plan cannot be changed.
problems.liquidsoap_unavailable: Liquidsoap cannot be reached. Try again when the playout is connected.
problems.missed_item_not_found: The missed item was not found.
problems.missed_item_resolved: The missed item was already rescheduled or dismissed.
problems.media_operation_running: Another import, analysis, or transcoding is running. Wait until it finishes.
problems.media_tools_unavailable: The audio tools (ffmpeg) are not available on the server.
problems.live_session_active: A live session is already running. Take it over to start a new one.
problems.live_offer_invalid: The browser's live connection request was not accepted.
problems.live_unavailable: The live voice bridge is not available on the server.
problems.network_error: The server cannot be reached. Check that the backend is running.
problems.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Try again.
problems.unexpected_response: The server sent an unexpected answer. Try again in a moment.
